name: @sieve/extension
description: Sieve Chrome extension: the badge and side panel for approving relay requests from the home base tab.

scripts.build:all: node scripts/build.mjs --mode dev && node scripts/build.mjs --mode release && node scripts/build.mjs --mode store
scripts.zip: node scripts/build.mjs --mode release && node scripts/build.mjs --mode store && node scripts/zip.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.e2e: node scripts/build.mjs --mode dev && node scripts/build.mjs --mode release && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
